review_notes.finding: Ads Manager campaign-level reference with Purchase ROAS sort indicator and core performance columns; visible rows are not numerically monotonic, so the image alone does not prove the actual sort order or clone threshold.

Smart Bidding page table exposes UTM_CAMPAIGN, FB Page, LEADS_TOTAL and LEADS; confirms LEADS—not LEADS_TOTAL—is the relevant visible balance, but the screenshot is historical state, not a durable threshold definition by itself.
Compact CPV reference with 14 columns, monospaced alignment, R/E signals and abbreviated actions; used as visual inspiration, not as Eggbev metric policy.
Wide Ads Manager header with Campaigns/Ad sets/Ads selections and performance columns; no final Eggbev report layout or thresholds shown.
Long canonical-route banner and duplicated pin notices created visual noise; supports the later no-banner/no-pinned-route policy.
Report headers were wrapped and horizontally split into fragments such as Cost per click/subscriber and Broadcast revenue; confirms the legibility defect Nicolas requested to fix.
Ideal CPV desktop layout uses repeated monospaced headers, fixed columns, ample spacing and R/E/action icons.
Ad set editor showed dataset Eggbev-US-CC-EN but Conversion event still unselected; evidence of an incomplete intermediate draft, not final policy.
Copy editor showed mixed headlines, five-star description, Apply now CTA and disabled text optimization; no event or placements visible.
Three marked headlines APPLY NOW, CARD APPROVED and APPLY CARD, five-star description, Apply now CTA, empty Primary text and disabled text/translation optimization.
AdG1 editor shows dataset Eggbev-US-CC-EN and selected active event eggbev-pv-u; screenshot still represents editor/draft state, while publication requires later readback.
Discord naming map shows CC_US_EN_VID_AVAILABLE_LIMIT_PV_112 through PV_132; campaign count, USD45 and 70% usage are one-time request details, not permanent defaults.
Historical report listed three ad cuts with spend USD0 and ROAS N/D; useful for chronology of Phase 2 behavior, not proof of current state.
Partial R/E and CPM cells with N/D; insufficient alone to define ROI color thresholds.
Messenger Pages table shows paired Revenue/Profit/ROI values and exact Page/UTM/account rows; second values are arithmetically coherent but the screenshot contains no explicit Estimated legend.
Campaign-level selection for Amy Shook pg_5024, but no creative preview; does not visually prove the asset bug.

Ad-level row identifies AD 02 / CC_US_EN_VID_AVAILABLE_LIMIT_PV_038 as the manager-designated invalid target; screenshot alone does not prove corruption, so invalidation authority comes from Nicolas's text.
Ads Manager is clearly at Ad level with per-row toggles, metrics and 4,935 ads; confirms cuts are performed on ads even when budget comes from campaign CBO.
Ideal wide desktop table with 16 columns, fixed monospaced spacing, Page, Ads detail, ROI real/estimated, Leads and action signals.
Compressed table leaves Ads crowded against ROI columns and wastes width after Action; concrete spacing/grid defect.
Rodolfo explicitly wrote 'pode deixar elas pra rodar agora'; screenshot contains no technical readback and belongs to referenced CPV context.

Messenger JSON modal shows prior Template name 'Start conversations 08/30/26', not JSON-AGT; supports Nicolas's later prospective naming correction, but image alone does not prove the new name was saved.
Thirteen active campaigns at USD45 show uneven early spend, with maximum visible consumption about 80.7%; screenshot does not expose 01:10 time, timezone or cause, so no causal rule can be inferred.
Desktop consolidated table with 16 columns and Page/UTM grouping; visible pg order is descending in the example, but Broadcast revenue is not shown and remains a separate human requirement.

Messenger Pages values for Eggbev Pages/UTMs show exact Investment, paired Revenue/Profit/ROI and operational metrics; screenshot demonstrates the reference source but not a second report for direct visual parity.
Part 2/3 table retains some emojis, but Part 3/3 content is cut and Ads markers show degraded glyphs; confirms partial—not global—emoji/layout regression.
Second regression screenshot shows per-ad stop/check markers, negative ROI columns and cropped CTR/rows; supports the fixed pagination/header requirement.
Exact filename Record_2026_08_31_22_04_13_66.mp4; no reusable rule or content visible in the screenshot.
Old report said budget write required Rodolfo/Geizian and envelope; Rodolfo's accompanying instruction superseded that for Eggbev by stating Nicolas controls without Rodolfo approval.
